acceptanceCriteria: Generic calls are masked only through their type-argument list.
A fixture with useMemo<T>( followed by a declaration keeps both; the test fails before the fix.
body: Residual from lane bf-1022q (PR beamfall/corvint#1547, seal 52f25c48d). Masking a generic call such as useMemo<T>( consumes the rest of the statement and the following line, so useMemo<T>( and similar generic calls cannot be supported and adjacent declarations are lost.
title: flowdocs: the TypeScript generic-call masker swallows the statement and the next line
